records.title: Toward Calibrated Mixture-of-Experts Under Distribution Shift
records.reason: The proposed adversarial reweighting changes the training objective to improve calibration under distribution shift. Experiments use CIFAR-10H, PACS, and CivilComments classifiers with four-expert MoEs; calibration/accuracy is measured, not LLM runtime, serving, memory, or throughput. It addresses prediction reliability rather than inference efficiency.

records.title: LayerRoute: Input-Conditioned Adaptive Layer Skipping via LoRA Fine-Tuning for Agentic Language Models
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract describes a plausible layer-skipping method, but the submission is withdrawn and the primary record reports no PDF/full text, so method, evaluation, and limitations cannot be verified.

records.title: Emissions transparency in AI research should be mandatory
records.reason: The publisher abstract is about mandatory disclosure of AI training energy/emissions and policy feasibility, not an LLM inference or serving method. The publisher abstract was retrieved after the packet’s abstract field was empty; it clearly states the scope.

records.title: Learning Multi-Modal Trajectory Policies for Data-Efficient Robotic Manipulation
records.reason: The paper learns data-efficient robotic manipulation trajectory policies; the contribution is policy learning, not LLM inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: TRACE: Discovering Task-Specific Parameter via Adaptation-Aware Probing for Continual Fine-Tuning
records.reason: The abstract studies task-specific parameters for continual fine-tuning, a training/adaptation contribution outside inference scope.
